expected.citations_raw: A-RULE-003 | 제6조 | p.1 | rev 1 | A-RULE-003 | 제12조 | p.1 | rev 1

expected.citations_raw: A-NOTICE-003 | Event | p.1 | rev 1 | A-NOTICE-003 | Registration | p.1 | rev 1
expected.facts: The summer sharing event will be held at the central plaza on July 25, 2026, from 17:00. | Residents must register in the management-office application by July 20.

expected.citations_raw: A-GUIDE-002 | 등록 | 문서 본문 | rev 1 | A-GUIDE-002 | 추가차량 | 문서 본문 | rev 1

expected.citations_raw: A-GUIDE-003 | Procedure | p.1 | rev 1 | A-GUIDE-003 | Time | p.1 | rev 1
